guard: authoritative membership inventory derives channels from validated exact keys so malformed durable rows are not omitted from retirement
command: pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/core build && pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/auth exec tsx smoke/freeslot-respawn-barrier.smoke.ts
why: lifecycleMemberships derives channels from validated exact keys so that unreadable/malformed membership rows
are included in the inventory and purged during terminal cleanup before the alias is freed.
Restoring the defective implementation that called listMembers omits undecodable rows from inventory,
causing the corrupt row to linger and the named safety assertion to fail.

mutations.name: restore defective listMembers complete inventory omission
mutations.find: const channels = await listLifecycleMemberChannels(await this.membersRegistry(), principal, uid);
mutations.replace: const rows = await listMembers(await this.membersRegistry(), { owner: principal }); const channels = [...new Set(rows.filter((r) => r.lifecycleUid === uid).map((r) => r.channel))].sort();
mutations.expectRed: SAFETY: corrupt lifecycle-keyed membership row is gone before alias is freed
mutations.cell: SAFETY: corrupt lifecycle-keyed membership row is gone before alias is freed
